title: Coox dacrisa mari
intro: qaxmeqe caxaaxuwih addat, ayyunti gibdi xagana abe. takkay immay ken fidga gibbatimteh sugte qibaadah idni gaba culsa abte wak, ken acwa ardi fan milaagta wak.
clues: Nanu mango caxaaxuwih caxaaxuwih barkat luk sugne, takkay immay nanu kaxxiinitak sugne.
Nanu baacoytit tabaatabse kalah gaaboysoh ekraaro bicisne.
Nanu ninni ekraarol kibal luk, saakuuk xabba haanam genne.
takkay immay nanu gufne wak, ni caxaaxuwih arac inki bar finqitem geyne.
Nanu ninni qellat cedneeh, ittal essernam qemmisne.
Nanu ellecaboh toobitneh, takkay immay baritto raagteh barinne.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Coox ramid yargiqeh yan kaxxa caacay

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Oson toobiteenih takkay immay sinni caxaaxuwi arac weenih
outcome.answer: Oson toobiteenih takkay immay sinni caxaaxuwi arac weenih

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
